rationale: The stock gapped down ~22.5% at the open and has since bounced from the session low of $13.46 to $14.30, placing price at 78.5% of today's range — meaning most of the intraday recovery is already priced in with limited upside to the session high of $14.53. The 1-minute candles show very low momentum (tight range, mixed direction, one anomalously low-volume bar), and the current price sits above both VWAP ($14.15) and the 9-EMA ($14.22), offering no clean mean-reversion setup in either direction. With today already showing a realized loss and no clear structural edge for continuation or reversal at this level, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
